features_implemented: Screenshot-led AI ASSistant UI with the user palette (#1a1a1a main, #202020 260px sidebar, #242424 composer, #d48264 accent), settings, user/apps dialogs, title/menu bar and Today view
Local Ollama model selector; default qwen2.5:3b; no automatic model pull or cloud fallback; remote/cloud aliases rejected
Vision/thinking only when selected installed Ollama metadata verifies capability; images max 2 MB and stored in browser IndexedDB after explicit send
Explicit HTML/SVG artifacts only; inline visualizer and workbench preview use restrictive CSP and iframe sandbox without allow-same-origin
Artifact versions stored locally; exact vault root, immutable artifact/note paths and complete source shown before explicit Obsidian save
Downloaded artifact source warns it is no longer isolated; no remote hosting/deployment
Pin selection to edit (max 4,000 chars, optional note) adds an unsent quoted draft and preserves existing draft; never auto-sends
Branch here copies only a transcript prefix with fresh message/artifact IDs, reuses local attachment blobs, preserves original, captures branch locally
Same-origin policy-filtered Ollama/vault proxies; static preview shares policy, strips cookies/authorization, rejects traversal, loopback default
Vault context preview before composer injection; blacklist manager, capsules, Today view, local chat history and honest failure states
Vault API immutable Markdown captures, Asia/Dhaka dates, path/symlink guards and honest write acknowledgements
